_meta.method: Personal live HTTP GET of every catalog searchURL (desktop Chrome UA, 12s timeout). Lock only a confirmed tax-collecting-entity search/pay page. County homepages, property-appraiser/CAD hosts, 404s, and Cloudflare-off-vendor redirects are not locks. Empty rows stay empty — no invented URLs. Florida: official collector pages (Alachua /property-taxes/, Brevard SEARCH or PAY ONLINE, Sarasota View/Pay Taxes) point at {county}.county-taxes.com/public; that host 403s behind Cloudflare when it exists and 404s when it does not. XPaths are from live HTML when the form is server-rendered; SPA labels are from the compiled bundle.

catalog.collector_search_locks: confirmed vendor/search portals only (county-taxes.com, LandNav, Spatialest, WebPayments, eProptax, ark.org, treasurer PIN, etc.)
catalog.empty_or_unverified: homepage / assessor / dead / unknown_live / empty remain needs_correction until a collector search page is confirmed

CA-SanDiego.state_entity: California — county Treasurer-Tax Collector collects secured property tax (Cal. Rev. & Tax. Code). Assessor/Recorder/County Clerk (ARCC) is values/records, not the pay/search page.
CA-SanDiego.how_found: Opened the Treasurer-Tax Collector WebPayments search URL (not sandiegocounty.gov assessor ARCC). Live 200, title WebPayments, React SPA at /webpayments/static/js/main.5bea859a.js. Bundle strings: Search Property Tax Information; Search by one of the following 3 options; Parcel Number; Owner; Option 2: Mailing Address; Option 3: Unsecured Bill Number; Begin Search.

steps: Open https://wps.sdttc.com/WebPayments/CoSDTreasurer2/search (Treasurer-Tax Collector WebPayments). Never ARCC.
Search by Parcel Number first (San Diego format ###-###-##-##, e.g. 325-061-08-00).
If the parcel is unknown, search by owner last name or mailing address.
Unsecured bills use Option 3: Unsecured Bill Number.
Confirm amounts on that collector page before closing.
method.notes: SPA: form controls render after JS. Target labels Parcel Number / Owner / Mailing Address.

WI-Chippewa.collector: Chippewa County Treasurer — Catalis LandNav public portal
WI-Chippewa.state_entity: Wisconsin — county treasurer collects postponed/delinquent real estate tax (Wis. Stat. ch. 74). Current December/January installments are paid to the LOCAL municipal treasurer.
WI-Chippewa.how_found: Live 200 title Catalis - Login. Guest form is public; staff form is not. Official county site chippewacountywi.gov; chippewacounty.gov is dead.

steps: Open the LandNav login URL.
Submit form#GuestLoginForm (Guest Sign In). Do not use StaffLoginForm.
Search by parcel number, owner last name (less is more), or house number + street.
Max 10 parcels per payment cart.
Current Dec/Jan installments: local municipal treasurer, not always this portal.
method.notes: After guest login the search fields are inside the LandNav app (parcel / last name / address).

CO-Denver.collector: City and County of Denver — Spatialest property record search
CO-Denver.state_entity: Colorado — combined city-and-county. Spatialest is the interactive record search; denvergov.org/Assessor is a brochure.
CO-Denver.how_found: Live 200 title City & County of Denver - Property Record Search. Client-rendered Spatialest. Reject denvergov.org/Assessor.

steps: Open https://property.spatialest.com/co/denver#/
Use the Spatialest search box for parcel, owner, or address.
Do not send the user to denvergov.org/Assessor.
method.notes: SPA — search input is painted after JS.

IL-Cook.state_entity: Illinois — County Treasurer collects; Assessor sets values. cookcountypropertyinfo.com is assessment, not the pay page.
IL-Cook.how_found: Live redirect yourpropertytaxoverviewsearch.aspx → setsearchparameters.aspx 200. Server-rendered PIN boxes txtPIN1–txtPIN5.

steps: Open https://www.cookcountytreasurer.com/setsearchparameters.aspx
Enter the 14-digit PIN across the five boxes (##-##-###-###-####).
Submit Continue. Confirm tax due on the Treasurer result — not cookcountypropertyinfo.com.
method.notes: PIN is split across five inputs. form#form1 posts to setsearchparameters.aspx.

TX-Harris.state_entity: Texas — Tax Assessor-Collector collects. CAD (harriscountytax.org / appraisal) is values only. Never send a pay-taxes user to the CAD or to harriscountytx.gov.
TX-Harris.how_found: Live hctax.net 200 Tax Office hub, Search Tax Statements points to myharriscountytax.com 200. Catalog harriscountytx.gov is a county homepage.

steps: Open https://myharriscountytax.com/ — service of the Harris County Tax Office.
Search the account / parcel there. Do not use harriscountytx.gov.
Office hub for context only: https://www.hctax.net/Property/PropertyTax
method.notes: Pay portal is a SPA. Receipt search on hctax.net uses #txtSearchReceiptValue — that is receipts, not the parcel tax search.

CA-Orange.how_found: Live 200 title Tax Search | OC Treasurer-Tax Collector. Angular app-root. Description: search and pay secured, unsecured, and supplemental.

steps: Open https://taxbill.octreasurer.gov/
Search the tax bill (parcel / account). Confirm amounts there.
method.notes: Angular SPA — inputs render in app-root after JS.

CA-LosAngeles.collector: Los Angeles County Treasurer and Tax Collector
CA-LosAngeles.state_entity: California — TTC collects. Assessor is values. propertytax.lacounty.gov is the public tax portal landing (200 on 2026-09-29) and links to ttc.lacounty.gov pay options. It is not itself the AIN form.
CA-LosAngeles.how_found: Live 200 title Los Angeles County - Property Tax Portal. Pay-your-property-taxes on ttc.lacounty.gov is informational. Keep the portal URL as the locked public entry; work with the user if they need a specific AIN inquiry form.

steps: Open https://www.propertytax.lacounty.gov/ (LA County Property Tax Portal).
Use Public Inquiry / tax bill tools on that portal. AIN is the LA parcel identifier.
Do not send the user to assessor.lacounty.gov for paying taxes.
method.notes: Portal landing, not a single AIN input. Link is locked because it is the official tax portal, not an assessor brochure.

steps: Do not open the 404 catalog URL.

FL-Alachua.state_entity: Florida — the elected county Tax Collector collects; the Property Appraiser is values only.
FL-Alachua.how_found: Live GET alachuacollector.com 200 is the office homepage (CMS site search name=search_query is not parcel search). /property-taxes/ 200 title Property Taxes – Alachua County Tax Collector links SEARCH/PAY to https://alachua.county-taxes.com/public and county-taxes.net/alachua. Bot GET of the vendor URL is Cloudflare 403 Just a moment; the host 404s for Florida counties that do not use the vendor, so 403 means the portal exists. Same vendor CTA is labeled SEARCH or PAY ONLINE on Brevard and View/Pay Taxes on Sarasota.

steps: Open https://alachua.county-taxes.com/public (Search or Pay), not the alachuacollector.com homepage.
Search by parcel / account / owner on that vendor portal.
Do not send a pay-taxes user to the Property Appraiser.
method.notes: Cloudflare may challenge automated clients; a browser can open the public portal. Guest search is on county-taxes.com/public.

CA-Alameda.how_found: Catalog URL propertytax.alamedacountyca.gov live 200. Hostname is the official property-tax portal (same pattern as LA County propertytax.lacounty.gov). HTML is an Imperva/bot-wall shell with no server-rendered title; still the TTC portal, not the assessor.

steps: Open https://propertytax.alamedacountyca.gov/
Use the Treasurer-Tax Collector property tax search there.
method.notes: Bot-wall SPA. Present the portal URL; work with the user if a specific AIN form is needed.
